description: Read-only invoices (R5): a `statuses` filter through InvoiceService and both read paths, PortalInvoiceReader, the PortalInvoice allowlist projection (with account display names), the reportlab invoice PDF, the scoped CSV export through services/csv_export.py, the invoice routes, and their tests. The payment_attempt field on the invoice detail is wired to PortalPaymentAttemptStore in FEAT-005; here it is always null. Design §2.4 (invoice row), §3.2, §5, D8, DV9. Depends on FEAT-001; independent of FEAT-002 and FEAT-003.
steps: 1. Add statuses: Optional[Sequence[str]] = None (ES terms / SQL IN, applied together with status) to InvoiceService.list/count and _invoice_must_clauses in commerce/services/invoice_service.py, InvoiceReadRepository.list/count in persistence/read_repositories.py, and read_invoice_list/read_invoice_count in commerce/services/commerce_persistence_bridge.py. Re-read the post-rebase invoice_service.py first (OI-14 changed it).

2. portal/services/scoped_readers.py PortalInvoiceReader.list/count (tenant_id + customer_id + statuses=PORTAL_INVOICE_STATUSES or [status]) and get (tenant get, then customer_id mismatch or draft -> the same resource_not_found(f"Invoice '{id}' not found", details={'invoice_id': id}) as a miss). portal/services/projection.py PortalInvoice projection (fields exactly as design §5; unit_price_cents via services.money.legacy_unit_price_cents; delivery only delivered_at/actual_gallons/ticket_number; payable rule; account_display_name map from AccountService.list following next_cursor up to 500, WARN + 'Account' on error). portal/models.py PortalInvoice + line item models (extra='forbid').

3. portal/services/invoice_pdf.py render_invoice_pdf(invoice: PortalInvoice, *, supplier_name, customer_display_name) -> bytes with the reportlab canvas API like the BOL renderer (letter, 30 line items per page). portal/services/portal_invoice_service.py orchestrates list/detail/pdf/csv. services/csv_export.py ExportType gains 'portal_invoices'; PORTAL_INVOICE_EXPORT_COLUMNS as in §5; source adapted from _invoice_export_source to call PortalInvoiceReader.

4. portal/api/invoice_endpoints.py: require_portal_invoicing (404 INVOICING_DISABLED when backbone/invoicing off or service missing); GET /api/portal/invoices (read limit; status enum without draft; start_date/end_date through services.date_range.parse_date_range on created_at), GET /invoices/export declared BEFORE /invoices/{invoice_id} (download limit = EXPORT_RATE_LIMIT, key portal_rate_key), GET /invoices/{invoice_id}, GET /invoices/{invoice_id}/pdf (application/pdf, Content-Disposition attachment with the sanitized filename; render error -> ERROR log + 500 'Invoice PDF could not be generated'). Mount; wire the service in bootstrap/core.py when invoicing is configured.

5. Tests in Runsheet-backend/tests/portal/: test_portal_invoices.py (INV-1 incl. the draft-exclusion case against both the ES fake and the commerce_persistence_bridge path, void labelled 'Void', PDF text via pypdf contains only projected values, CSV BOM + '=' escaping + scope rows + 413 cap), add invoice/PDF/CSV cases to test_portal_isolation.py (ISO-C-1, ISO-C-2 parsed CSV, ISO-T-1), test_scoped_readers.py (ISO-C-3 spy on InvoiceService.list/count), test_portal_projection.py (ISO-C-6: full delivery_result with driver id, recipient, photos, geotag, signature never appears in list, detail, PDF text or CSV), and extend tests/commerce/test_invoice_status_filter.py for statuses. Existing commerce invoice tests pass unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: Draft invoices never appear in the portal list or CSV and are 404 by id, PDF and payment paths; void invoices are listed with label 'Void' (INV-1 passes on both read paths)
The PDF response is application/pdf with filename invoice_<sanitized>.pdf and its extracted text contains no restricted values (ISO-C-6 passes)
Customer A gets 404 with the unknown-id body for B's and T2's invoices and PDFs; A's list and parsed CSV contain only A's invoices
With invoicing disabled all invoice routes return 404 INVOICING_DISABLED and /me shows invoices_available=false
verification: cd <wt>/Runsheet-backend && ENVIRONMENT=test JWT_SECRET=ci-test-jwt-secret JWT_ALGORITHM=HS256 REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6379 <venv>/bin/python -m pytest tests/portal tests/commerce tests/unit/test_csv_export_helper.py -q --no-cov
python scripts/generate_endpoint_registry.py, commit, git diff --exit-code docs/endpoint-registry.md
findings:
Code commit 5221451 on production-readiness/customer-portal (not pushed). No migration change (single head 0011_customer_portal). main.py untouched (172 effective / 350 total); the invoice router is appended to portal.api.routers.

MODULES / NAMES CREATED
- statuses filter (step 1): commerce/services/invoice_service.py _invoice_must_clauses(..., statuses=None) adds {'terms': {'status': [...]}} next to the status term; InvoiceService.list/count(statuses=None). persistence/read_repositories.py InvoiceReadRepository._list_filters/list/count(statuses=None) -> InvoiceORM.status.in_(...). commerce/services/commerce_persistence_bridge.py read_invoice_list/read_invoice_count(tenant_id, *, statuses=None, **kwargs). An EMPTY statuses sequence matches nothing (fails closed); None means no filter. InvoiceService only forwards statuses to the bridge when it is not None, so existing bridge mocks/call assertions are unchanged.
- portal/services/scoped_readers.py: PORTAL_INVOICE_STATUSES = ('open','partial','paid','overdue','void'); invoice_not_found(id) (same constructor/message as InvoiceService.get miss); PortalInvoiceReader(invoice_service): list(scope, *, limit, cursor=None, status=None, created_from/created_before/created_until) -> Page; count(scope, *, status=None, created_*) -> int; get(scope, id) -> dict (404 for miss, other customer, draft); get_or_none(scope, id). status=None -> statuses=PORTAL_INVOICE_STATUSES; a status outside that set (draft) -> statuses=[] (nothing). Portal cursor is opaque encode_cursor([created_at, invoice_id]); the reader re-checks the cursor's invoice through get_or_none before passing invoice_id to the service, so a cursor naming another customer's (or an unknown) invoice is 422 VALIDATION_ERROR details.fields=['cursor'] (no cross-customer existence oracle). The reader is NOT in the PortalReaders registry; it lives inside PortalInvoiceService.
- portal/services/projection.py: INVOICE_STATUS_LABELS {open:'Open', partial:'Partially paid', paid:'Paid', overdue:'Overdue', void:'Void'}; PAYABLE_INVOICE_STATUSES; MIN_PAYMENT_CENTS=100; DEFAULT_ACCOUNT_NAME='Account'; ACCOUNT_PAGE_SIZE=200; ACCOUNT_NAME_CAP=500; async account_display_names(account_service, scope) -> {account_id: display_name} (AccountService.list(tenant, customer_id=, cursor=, limit=200) following next_cursor, cap 500, any error -> WARN 'portal invoices: account list failed' + {}); project_invoice(doc, *, account_names, payments_available, payment_attempt=None) -> PortalInvoice (unit_price_cents = legacy_unit_price_cents(unit_price_micros_from_record(line)); delivery only delivered_at/actual_gallons/ticket_number; payable = payments_available and status in open/partial/overdue and remaining_cents >= 100); invoice_total_gallons(PortalInvoice).
- portal/models.py: PortalInvoiceLineItem, PortalInvoiceDelivery, PortalInvoicePaymentAttempt {payment_attempt_id, status_code, status_label, amount_cents, created_at}, PortalInvoice (fields exactly design §5), PortalInvoiceEnvelope, PortalInvoiceListEnvelope (all extra='forbid').
- portal/services/invoice_pdf.py: render_invoice_pdf(invoice: PortalInvoice, *, supplier_name, customer_display_name) -> bytes (reportlab canvas, letter, LINES_PER_PAGE=30, 'Page n of m', totals on the last page); money(cents) -> '$1,234.56'.
- portal/services/portal_invoice_service.py: PortalInvoiceService(reader, *, account_service=None, customer_service=None) with list(scope, InvoiceFilters, *, limit, cursor) -> (items, next_cursor), detail(scope, id), pdf(scope, id) -> (bytes, filename), export(request, scope, InvoiceFilters) -> StreamingResponse; InvoiceFilters(status, start_date, end_date).service_kwargs() (parse_date_range on created_at, D8/DV9); PORTAL_INVOICE_EXPORT_COLUMNS (invoice_number [falls back to invoice_id], issued_at, due_date, status [the label], account, total_gallons, subtotal, tax, total, paid, remaining; money as Decimal dollars '296.60'); pdf_filename(); PDF_ERROR_MESSAGE. payments_available is computed per request as portal_payment_service.portal_connector(tenant) is not None, so payable is false until FEAT-005 configures the portal factory. detail() has the comment where FEAT-005 must add payment_attempt (pass payment_attempt= to project_invoice). Registry: configure_portal_invoices / get_configured_invoice_service / wire_portal_invoices(invoice_service=, account_service=, customer_service=). bootstrap/core.py calls wire_portal_invoices right after configure_invoice_api (inside the same try), with container.commerce_account_service and commerce_customer_service when present.
- services/csv_export.py: ExportType gains 'portal_invoices'.
- portal/api/invoice_endpoints.py: PortalInvoiceStatus enum (no draft); require_portal_invoicing(scope=Depends(require_portal_customer)) -> 404 INVOICING_DISABLED ('Invoices are not available') when backbone or invoicing is off or no PortalInvoiceService is configured; list_portal_invoices (GET /api/portal/invoices, read bucket, limit 1-50 default 25, cursor <=256, status, start_date/end_date <=64), export_portal_invoices (GET /invoices/export, declared before /{invoice_id}, @limiter.limit(EXPORT_RATE_LIMIT, key_func=portal_rate_key)), get_portal_invoice (GET /invoices/{invoice_id}, read bucket), get_portal_invoice_pdf (GET /invoices/{invoice_id}/pdf, EXPORT_RATE_LIMIT; application/pdf, Content-Disposition attachment; filename=\"invoice_<safe>.pdf\"). Malformed ids -> same 404 as unknown. A render error -> ERROR log 'portal invoice pdf render failed' (extra_data invoice_id, tenant_id) and 500 INTERNAL_ERROR 'Invoice PDF could not be generated'.

TEST SEAMS (tests/portal/conftest.py)
- portal_fakes now ALWAYS wires an InvoiceHarness (portal_fakes.invoices) and sets COMMERCE_READ_FROM_POSTGRES=false; portal_fakes.invoice_service is now that harness's real InvoiceService (was object()). It restores the previous portal invoice service after the test. Without seeding, invoice routes answer 200 [] / 404, which the generic AUD-1 / RL-1 / ISO-T-2 / XR-6 / XR-8 suites accept (RL-1 needed the service configured so the read limit is reached before the 404 dependency).
- InvoiceHarness(store: InMemoryDocumentStore, service: InvoiceService, accounts: FakeAccountService, portal: PortalInvoiceService, now). add_invoice(tenant, customer, invoice_id, *, status='open', account_id='QA-ACCT-1', created_at=None, invoice_number=None [default 'INV-<id>'], lines=1, **overrides) builds a commerce Invoice doc (1 line: PROPANE 100 gal, 2_966_000 micros, subtotal 29660, tax 1000, order_id 'QA-ORDER-SECRET'). build_invoice_harness(customer_service). seed_invoice_isolation(h) -> {'A'|'B'|'C': {status: 'QA-INV-<L>-<status>'}} for all 6 statuses incl. draft, accounts 'QA-ACCT-<L>' named 'Account <L> Main'.
- FakeAccountService (offset cursors '200','400'; .calls, .fail); RESTRICTED_DELIVERY_RESULT and RESTRICTED_INVOICE_VALUES for ISO-C-6.
- Download routes are 5/min per user per route (EXPORT_RATE_LIMIT): tests that call /pdf or /export repeatedly must use fresh sessions or few calls.
- FEAT-005: PAY-7's draft-invoice 404 and payment create on B's invoice (ISO-C-1) should reuse seed_invoice_isolation; the payment-create path should read the invoice through PortalInvoiceReader.get (draft/out-of-scope -> invoice_not_found).

TESTS ADDED
- tests/commerce/test_invoice_status_filter.py: must-clause unit, ES path (InMemoryDocumentStore) and bridge path (SQLite, read cutover on) statuses cases; the 3 existing tests unchanged.
- tests/portal/test_portal_invoices.py (INV-1, 14 tests): list excludes drafts, newest first, Void label, account name, payable false, unit price from micros; draft 404 by id and PDF; detail + status filter (draft/bogus 422); created_at date filter + 422; pagination + foreign/garbage cursor 422; account-name fallback + WARN + customer_id on every AccountService call; name map cap 500 following cursors; bridge-path draft exclusion through the real app (httpx ASGITransport, one event loop) for list, detail, foreign id and CSV; PDF headers, sanitized filename, 2 pages for 31 lines, pypdf text; PDF render error 500; CSV BOM/header/'=' escaping/scope/status filter/decimal dollars; 413 EXPORT_TOO_LARGE (MAX_EXPORT_ROWS patched to 4); invoicing off -> all 4 routes 404 INVOICING_DISABLED and /me invoices_available=false; service unconfigured -> 404.
- test_portal_isolation.py: test_customer_a_cannot_read_b_invoices (ISO-C-1: detail for all 6 of B's statuses, PDF for draft/open), test_invoice_lists_and_csv_contain_only_own_rows (ISO-C-2 incl. parsed CSV), test_invoice_tenant_boundary (ISO-T-1 both directions).
- test_scoped_readers.py: test_invoice_store_calls_carry_customer_id (ISO-C-3 spy on list/count), out-of-scope/draft get is the miss 404, empty scope refused with no store call.
- test_portal_projection.py: test_invoice_responses_hide_restricted_fields (ISO-C-6: full delivery_result with driver id, recipient, photos, geotag, signature; list, detail, PDF text, CSV contain none of the restricted keys/values).

DEVIATIONS / CHOICES (minor, recorded for review)
- D-F4-1 Status labels other than 'Void' are not in the spec; chose Open / Partially paid / Paid / Overdue / Void. The CSV 'status' column carries the label (not the code).
- D-F4-2 The portal list cursor is opaque base64url([created_at, invoice_id]) and scope-checked (422 for foreign/unknown), instead of passing the service's raw invoice_id cursor through; this closes a cross-customer id-existence oracle via InvalidCursorError. Costs one extra InvoiceService.get per paged request (and per CSV page).
- D-F4-3 CSV invoice_number falls back to invoice_id when the invoice has no number (PG test rows); due_date is projected as a date (also accepts a datetime string).
- D-F4-4 The PDF route uses the download limit (EXPORT_RATE_LIMIT, 5/min per user per route) like the CSV, per the §3 table.
- D-F4-5 The PDF shows supplier_name = tenant_id (B1/DV1) and the customer display name from CustomerService.get ('' on error, WARN).
